title: Getting Started with Word
description: Word creates editable documents; a blank document is a safe place to practise.
objectives: Use File → New to complete a practical task.
Check the result: A saved document containing your welcome sentence.
concepts: Word creates editable documents; a blank document is a safe place to practise.
Command location: File → New. Desktop Windows instructions are used; Mac and web controls may differ.
steps: Launch Word
Choose Blank document
Type Welcome to my learning journal
Press Ctrl+S and save as Learning journal.docx
expectedResult: A saved document containing your welcome sentence.
tips: Work on a practice copy and save after each major change.
Compare your finished output with the expected result before moving on.
mistakes: Closing the app before saving
